title: Jack Campbell: I didn't need to be highest-paid LB, I wanted to remain a Lion

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jack Campbell: I didn't need to be highest-paid LB, I wanted to remain a Lion
sources.description: The Lions didn't exercise their option on linebacker Jack Campbell's contract for the 2027 season, but they said the move didn't change their desire to keep Campbell in Detroit for the long term.
